sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vijay Bahadur Yadav,Ankit Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel.
2. The present petition has been filed challenging an order dated 05.07.2024.
3. Learned Standing Counsel has raised a preliminary objection that an appeal is prescribed against the said order.
4. In view thereof, the present petition is disposed of permitting the petitioner to prefer an appeal and in case, the appeal is preferred, the same shall be decided in accordance with law.
